comment: Hand-transcribed expected ubus rc.init decisions for luci-mod-system-init and luci-mod-system-config from pinned uhttpd uh_ubus_allowed, startup.js / system.js rpc.declare, and ACL JSON. Not generated from the Python evaluator.
notes: uh_ubus_allowed requires session.access scope=ubus object=rc function=init (uhttpd omits scope).
Bounded to startup.js and system.js rpc.declare object=rc method=init at luci b2e0be4b. That is rpcd rc.c, not luci.setInitAction.
Fixture login luci-mod-system-init is write of the existing ACL group. luci-mod-system-config already exists and also grants rc.init.
Do not invent a setInitAction luci-ssl grant. rc.list is not this slice.
Missing SID is JSON-RPC ERROR_PARSE, not the all-zero sentinel.
Root list read/write '*' is stock rpcd.config, not a violation (expectation_id root-administration).
Do not emit dispatcher, authorization_violation, path_found, luci object grants, or execl of /etc/init.d.
shellquote and basename are not sanitizers.
luci-mod-system flash.js write sysupgrade/firstboot stay unstaffed.
luci-mod-network diagnostics ping is not this slice.
crontab.js cron reload is not this slice (ubus file.write, not file.exec).

rule_refs: luci@b2e0be4b luci-base.json unauthenticated grants only luci.getFeatures
rpcd@d99f703 unauthenticated.json has no ubus rc.init
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c uh_ubus_allowed: session.access rc/init false -> ERROR_ACCESS
do not invent an unauthenticated rc.init grant
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c parse_call_params: missing SID with no_ubusauth=0 is ERROR_PARSE
missing SID is not rewritten to 0000... in luci-ssl-25.12

cases.note: Fixture login luci-mod-system-init is not a stock device login. startup.js uses rpc.declare object=rc method=init. Intended_access, not a violation and not a PoC.
rule_refs: fixture rpcd.config login luci-mod-system-init list write luci-mod-system-init

cases.note: Existing luci-mod-system-config write fixture already grants rc.init. system.js uses rpc.declare object=rc method=init for sysntpd restart. Intended_access, not a violation and not a PoC.
rule_refs: fixture rpcd.config login luci-mod-system-config list write luci-mod-system-config

cases.note: The list-read flash fixture has ubus file.exec, not rc.init. ERROR_ACCESS at uh_ubus_allowed. Do not invent a write flash login.
luci.setInitAction has no luci-ssl delegated grant at luci b2e0be4b. This slice is rpcd rc.init, not the luci object method.
rule_refs: do not invent a setInitAction luci-ssl grant

cases.note: rpcd write implies read, so the write luci-mod-system-init fixture also matches read ubus rc.list at uh_ubus_allowed. This slice does not emit a rc.list grant.
rule_refs: rpcd session.c login_test_permission: write implies read

cases.note: Stock root list read/write '*' is intended_access (root-administration), not a violation.
rule_refs: openwrt@4e964251 package overlay rpcd.config root read/write '*'
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c parse_call_params: explicit data:null is not a table and returns ERROR_PARSE
omitted data defaults to an empty table in the policy wrapper; explicit JSON null remains null
